generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a little while.
offline: We couldn't reach the server. Check the network and try again.
removeFailed: The read access couldn't be removed. Try again.
step1: Step 1 of 2: Choose the folders with the minutes
step1Text: Tick one or more folders. In the next step you see the meetings in them and choose which to import.
selected: {count, plural, one {# folder selected} other {# folders selected}}
subfoldersText: For example one folder per term or year.
showMeetings: Show the meetings in {count, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}
autoRemoved: Simon Says' read access to your Drive is removed automatically after 24 hours.

hint.template: Looks like a template, notice or agenda, not minutes.
hint.docx: Word file. Open it in Google Docs and save it as a Google Doc to be able to import it.
hint.own: Simon Says' own meeting document. The meeting is already included.
hint.imported: Tick to import it again (for example if the document has more meetings now).

searching: Looking for minutes in {count, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}
noDocs: No Google Docs in {count, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}.
docsIn: {files, plural, one {# document} other {# documents}} in {folders, plural, one {# folder} other {# folders}}, oldest first.
alreadyImported: {count, plural, one {# is} other {# are}} already imported.
guessed: Dates marked “guessed” don't come from the name; Simon Says reads the real date from the minutes.
truncated: The folders contain more documents than Simon Says shows at once. Choose fewer folders, or turn off subfolders, to see the rest.
pickOldest: Select the {max} oldest not yet imported
tooMany: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes} other {# sets of minutes}} selected. You can import at most {max} at a time; take the rest next time.
picked: {count, plural, one {# set of minutes} other {# sets of minutes}} selected. The next step shows what it costs; nothing is sent yet.
continueWith: Continue with {count, plural, one {# set of minutes} other {# sets of minutes}}
